question_en: Is there a fee-adjusted Polymarket edge?
question_zh: Polymarket 上有没有扣完费的优势？
sub_en: 629 markets scanned. 0 raw “edge.” 0 survived fees and a full exclusive set.
sub_zh: 扫了 629 个市场。生结果 0 条边。扣费并核完整分区后是 0。

fee.note_en: Use each market’s feeSchedule.rate when feesEnabled. Never assume 0.
fee.note_zh: feesEnabled 时用该市场 feeSchedule.rate，不默认 0。

fed.note_en: PM exclusive +25bp is not a CME target-rate bin. Gap 6.8pp is below the ~8–10pp mismatch bar. Buying the whole NegRisk set costs 1.0232 after 5% fees — no edge.
fed.note_zh: PM 独家 +25bp 不是 CME 目标利率档。缺口 6.8 个百分点低于约 8–10 个百分点的错配门槛。整组 NegRisk 扣 5% 费后成本 1.0232，无边。
fed.recheck_en: Re-check if: (1) contracts are definition-matched, AND (2) NegRisk net cost/share < 1 after live feeSchedule, AND (3) the expensive legs still have size.
fed.recheck_zh: 重检条件：定义对齐，且 NegRisk 扣现费后净成本 < 1，且贵的那几条仍有深度。

receipt.title: Fed Decision in September?
receipt.reason_en: Exclusive NegRisk Yes-asks sum to 1.012; after feeSchedule.rate=0.05 net cost/share is 1.023156 (>1). No fee-adjusted edge.
receipt.reason_zh: 互斥 NegRisk Yes 卖一合计 1.012；按 feeSchedule.rate=0.05 扣费后净成本/股 1.023156（>1）。无扣费后优势。
receipt.recheck_en: Re-check if contracts are definition-matched to CME AND NegRisk net cost/share < 1 after live feeSchedule AND expensive legs still have size.
receipt.recheck_zh: 重检条件：与 CME 定义对齐，且 NegRisk 扣现费后净成本 < 1，且贵的腿仍有深度。

scan.near_miss_filter_en: Raw 218 is Yes+No (or exclusive-set) net within a few cents of $1. Most are 0.1¢ longshot dust. Watch list keeps incomplete partitions and econ books with real size.
scan.near_miss_filter_zh: 原始 218 条是 Yes+No（或互斥组）扣费后净成本离 $1 只差几分。多数是 0.1¢ 长尾尘埃。观察名单只留分区不完整、以及有真实深度的经济盘。
scan.count_rule_en: 629 = 619 Yes/No books + 10 NegRisk events. Full set in universe.json.
scan.count_rule_zh: 629 = 619 个 Yes/No 盘 + 10 个 NegRisk 事件。全集在 universe.json。

cpi.note_en: Internal T−2h freeze 11 Sep 18:39 CST; first public copy 14 Sep. n=1 day. Not a track record.
cpi.note_zh: 内部 T−2h 冻结 9/11 18:39 CST；第一次公开是 9/14。n=1，不是战绩。

nfp.note_en: Internal T−2h freeze 4 Sep 18:24 CST; first public copy 14 Sep. Street +56k. Print +162k landed in 150k+.
nfp.note_zh: 内部 T−2h 冻结 9/4 18:24 CST；第一次公开是 9/14。街上 +56k。公布 +162k 落在 150k+。

method.en: Audit, not a teaser. Scan exclusive NegRisk Yes-asks; reject any incomplete partition; apply that market’s feeSchedule.rate (fee = C × rate × p × (1−p); rebate ignored). A Fed gap counts only if contracts are definition-matched. Scorecards freeze T−2h modal Yes mid vs BLS first print. Engine stays private; every number on this page is in desk.json.
method.zh: 这是审计，不是预告页。扫互斥 NegRisk 的 Yes 卖一；分区不完整就否；用该市场 feeSchedule.rate（fee = C × rate × p × (1−p)，忽略返佣）。利率缺口只在定义对齐时才算。记分卡用 T−2h 众数 Yes mid 对 BLS 首次。引擎不公开；这页每个数都在 desk.json。

watch.title: Democratic Presidential Nominee 2028
watch.missing_en: Person-*/Other placeholder legs inactive. Counted 51 named asks of ~128 markets — exclusive set incomplete.
watch.missing_zh: Person-*/Other 占位腿未激活。约 128 个市场里只计入 51 条具名卖一——互斥组不完整。
watch.distance_en: Not a price miss — required outcomes are off the live exclusive set.
watch.recheck_en: When every required nominee shows a live ask, the set is exhaustive, and sum(ask)+fees < 1 with size on every leg.
watch.recheck_zh: 每个必须覆盖的提名人都有卖一、集合穷尽、每条有深度，且 ask+费 < 1。

watch.title: Fed Decision in September?
watch.missing_en: NegRisk net 2.32¢ over $1 after 5% fees. Also not definition-matched to CME.
watch.missing_zh: NegRisk 扣 5% 费后净成本比 $1 贵 2.32¢。且与 CME 合约口径不一致。
watch.distance_en: 2.32¢ / share above the $1 payout after fees.
watch.distance_zh: 扣费后每股比 $1 赔付贵 2.32¢。
watch.recheck_en: When contracts are definition-matched AND net cost/share < 1 after live feeSchedule AND expensive legs still have size.
watch.recheck_zh: 定义对齐，且扣现费后净成本 < 1，且贵的腿仍有深度。

watch.title: Fed −25bp after September meeting
watch.missing_en: Yes+No asks = 1.001; after 5% fees net 1.001150. Yes ask is 0.2¢ (size ~822152.7).
watch.recheck_en: When Yes ask + No ask + live fees < 1 with displayed size on both sides.
watch.recheck_zh: 两边卖一加现费 < 1，且两边都有展示深度。

history_policy.en: A freeze is pre-print only if the GitHub commit time is before the official release. CPI 11 Sep and NFP 4 Sep freezes were internal; first public copy is the 14 Sep 10:20 snapshot (commit c32856a). Later snapshots on 14–16 Sep are additional public pre-print freezes for FOMC 15–16 Sep. After a print, append a result snapshot without rewriting the freeze file.
history_policy.zh: 只有 GitHub commit 时间早于官方公布，冻盘才算事前。CPI 9/11 和非农 9/4 的冻结当时只在内部；第一次公开是 9/14 10:20 快照（commit c32856a）。9/14–16 的后续快照是 9/15–16 FOMC 的追加事前公开冻结。公布后只追加结果快照，不改写冻结文件。

notify.en: No push alerts. Poll desk.json. If verdict or scan.after_audit changes, the conclusion changed. GitHub commits are the publish log.
notify.zh: 没有推送。轮询 desk.json。verdict 或 scan.after_audit 变了就是结论变了。GitHub commit 是发布记录。

published_note_en: Scan captured 2026-09-16 10:05 CST. Pre-print freeze for FOMC 15–16 Sep (decision window / within 48h).
published_note_zh: 扫描采集于 2026-09-16 10:05 CST。9/15–16 FOMC 决策窗口内，追加事前公开冻结。

track.en: Countable freeze-vs-print starts at FOMC 15–16 Sep. CPI 11 Sep and NFP 4 Sep were internal.
track.zh: 可计分的冻盘对公布从 9/15–16 FOMC 开始。CPI 9/11 和非农 9/4 当时未公开。
